purpose: Verify authenticated indenter can submit an online booking requisition
preconditions: Authenticated user with IAM Principal token
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/ with valid payload
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and booking persisted with status 'pending'

purpose: Verify indenter can only view their own booking requisition details
preconditions: User A and User B authenticated; User A created booking #1
action_or_input: User B issues GET /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found

purpose: Verify non-caretaker cannot route or forward booking requests
preconditions: Authenticated indenter user (not caretaker)
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/route/ with action='forward'
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify indenter can retrieve list of their own submitted bookings
preconditions: Authenticated user with IAM Principal token
action_or_input: GET /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with user's bookings

purpose: Verify booking requisition persists planned arrival and departure times
preconditions: Authenticated indenter
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/ with check_in_time='14:00', check_out_time='11:00'
expected_result: Response and database record contain arrival and departure times

purpose: Verify booking requisition persists explicit occupant count
preconditions: Authenticated indenter
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/ with number_of_rooms=2, occupant_count=3
expected_result: Response and database record persist occupant_count=3

purpose: Verify Caretaker can check room availability before routing
preconditions: Pending booking request and caretaker session
action_or_input: GET /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/availability/ or review with availability payload
expected_result: Returns real-time room availability for requested dates

purpose: Verify email notification triggered upon booking submission
preconditions: Valid booking submission
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/
expected_result: Email notification queued to indenter in mail outbox

purpose: Verify email notification triggered upon booking rejection
preconditions: Booking in pending review
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/route/ action='reject'
expected_result: Rejection notice email queued to indenter in mail outbox

purpose: Verify indenter can submit pre-arrival modification request
preconditions: Approved booking exists
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/modify/ with updated dates
expected_result: HTTP 202 Accepted and modification request queued for Caretaker review

purpose: Verify indenter cancellation creates review request rather than direct cancel
preconditions: Approved booking exists
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/cancel/
expected_result: Status changes to 'cancellation_requested' pending caretaker confirmation

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record no-show and apply 50% one-day room charge
preconditions: Approved booking where guest failed to arrive on check-in date
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/no-show/
expected_result: Status set to 'no_show' and bill includes 50% 1-day room rate

purpose: Verify cancellation fee is submitted for Caretaker review
preconditions: Cancellation requested within 7 days
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/cancel/
expected_result: Cancellation fee queued for verification

purpose: Verify billing adjustment requires Caretaker confirmation
preconditions: Booking cancelled with charges
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/cancel/
expected_result: Bill pending Caretaker confirmation

purpose: Verify Caretaker confirmation required to release cancelled room
preconditions: Room allotted to booking
action_or_input: Indenter submits cancellation
expected_result: Room remains locked until Caretaker confirms cancellation

purpose: Verify billing selects tariff effective for stay date, not future tariff
preconditions: Tariff A effective 2026-01-01 (Rs 400), Tariff B effective 2026-12-01 (Rs 950); Stay on 2026-05-01
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/check-out/
expected_result: Daily rate of Rs 400 applied (Total Rs 800 for 2 days)

purpose: Verify meal cannot be reserved for booking not checked in
preconditions: Booking in pending status
action_or_input: Serializer validation on MealBooking for pending booking
expected_result: ValidationError: meals only permitted for checked-in guests

purpose: Verify meal date must fall within booking check-in and check-out dates
preconditions: Booking stay dates 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-03
action_or_input: Create MealBooking with date 2026-05-10
expected_result: ValidationError: Meal date outside stay duration

purpose: Verify billing includes no-show penalty in total amount
preconditions: Recorded no-show
action_or_input: Check bill generation for no-show booking
expected_result: Bill total equals 50% of 1-day tariff

purpose: Verify Caretaker can record offline cash settlement and timestamp
preconditions: Generated bill for checked out booking
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bills/1/settle/ with payment_mode='cash'
expected_result: is_settled_offline set to True with current timestamp

purpose: Verify guest bill verification signature/data is recorded at checkout
preconditions: Guest verifies charges at checkout
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/check-out/ with guest_verified=True
expected_result: Bill / stay record persists guest_verified status

purpose: Verify finalized and immutable bill cannot be overwritten on re-checkout
preconditions: Bill exists with is_immutable=True and total=950.00
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/check-out/ after tariff increase
expected_result: ValidationError or HTTP 400; bill total remains 950.00

purpose: Verify low inventory generates persistent threshold alert record
preconditions: InventoryItem quantity drops below minimum_threshold
action_or_input: InventoryItem quantity updated from 6 to 4 (threshold=5)
expected_result: Persistent Alert/Notification record created in database

purpose: Verify quantity equal to threshold is NOT considered low stock
preconditions: InventoryItem quantity=5, minimum_threshold=5
action_or_input: Check item.is_below_threshold()
expected_result: Returns False (only < threshold is low stock)

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge can approve existing replenishment request

action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/inventory/replenish/1/approve/

purpose: Verify email notification triggered upon booking approval
preconditions: In-charge approves booking
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/decision/ with decision='approve'
expected_result: Approval email queued in mail.outbox

purpose: Verify email notification triggered upon booking modification
preconditions: Booking modification submitted
action_or_input: Submit modification request
expected_result: Modification notice queued in mail.outbox

purpose: Verify email notification triggered upon booking cancellation
preconditions: Cancellation recorded
action_or_input: POST /api/visitor-hostel/bookings/1/cancel/
expected_result: Cancellation confirmation email queued in mail.outbox

purpose: Verify Caretaker email notification triggered when stock is low
preconditions: InventoryItem quantity falls below threshold
action_or_input: Update stock quantity to 3
expected_result: Email sent to Caretaker warning of low inventory
